audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Jacob's final poetic sayings over the sons, Reuben/Simeon/Levi rebuke, Judah royal imagery, Joseph blessing, and burial command.

verses.restored: Jacob called his sons and said, Gather yourselves, and I will tell you what will meet you in the latter days.

familiar.text: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

modern.text: Then Jacob called for his sons and said, “Gather around so that I can tell you what will happen to you in the days to come:

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶל בָּנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ וְאַגִּ֣ידָה לָכֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִֽים

verses.restored: Gather and hear, sons of Jacob; listen to Israel your father.

familiar.text: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

modern.text: Come together and listen, O sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.

original.text: הִקָּבְצ֥וּ וְשִׁמְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְשִׁמְע֖וּ אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֲבִיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might and the firstfruits of my strength, excess of dignity and excess of power.

familiar.text: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

modern.text: Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power.

original.text: רְאוּבֵן֙ בְּכֹ֣רִי אַ֔תָּה כֹּחִ֖י וְרֵאשִׁ֣ית אוֹנִ֑י יֶ֥תֶר שְׂאֵ֖ת וְיֶ֥תֶר עָֽז

verses.restored: Unstable as water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father’s bed; then you profaned it; he went up to my couch.

familiar.text: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

modern.text: Uncontrolled as the waters, you will no longer excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, onto my couch, and defiled it.

original.text: פַּ֤חַז כַּמַּ֨יִם֙ אַל תּוֹתַ֔ר כִּ֥י עָלִ֖יתָ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אָבִ֑יךָ אָ֥ז חִלַּ֖לְתָּ יְצוּעִ֥י עָלָֽה

verses.restored: Simeon and Levi are brothers; weapons of violence are their knives.

familiar.text: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.

modern.text: Simeon and Levi are brothers; their swords are weapons of violence.

original.text: שִׁמְע֥וֹן וְלֵוִ֖י אַחִ֑ים כְּלֵ֥י חָמָ֖ס מְכֵרֹתֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Let my soul not enter their council; let my glory not be joined to their assembly, for in their anger they killed men, and in their willfulness they hamstrung oxen.

familiar.text: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

modern.text: May I never enter their council; may I never join their assembly. For they kill men in their anger, and hamstring oxen on a whim.

original.text: בְּסֹדָם֙ אַל תָּבֹ֣א נַפְשִׁ֔י בִּקְהָלָ֖ם אַל תֵּחַ֣ד כְּבֹדִ֑י כִּ֤י בְאַפָּם֙ הָ֣רְגוּ אִ֔ישׁ וּבִרְצֹנָ֖ם עִקְּרוּ שֽׁוֹר

verses.restored: Cursed be their anger, for it is fierce, and their wrath, for it is harsh. I will divide them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel.

familiar.text: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

modern.text: Cursed be their anger, for it is strong, and their wrath, for it is cruel! I will disperse them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel.

original.text: אָר֤וּר אַפָּם֙ כִּ֣י עָ֔ז וְעֶבְרָתָ֖ם כִּ֣י קָשָׁ֑תָה אֲחַלְּקֵ֣ם בְּיַעֲקֹ֔ב וַאֲפִיצֵ֖ם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Judah, your brothers shall praise you; your hand shall be on the neck of your enemies; your father’s sons shall bow down to you.

familiar.text: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.

modern.text: Judah, your brothers shall praise you. Your hand shall be on the necks of your enemies; your father’s sons shall bow down to you.

original.text: יְהוּדָ֗ה אַתָּה֙ יוֹד֣וּךָ אַחֶ֔יךָ יָדְךָ֖ בְּעֹ֣רֶף אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ יִשְׁתַּחֲוּ֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּנֵ֥י אָבִֽיךָ

verses.restored: Judah is a lion’s cub; from prey, my son, you have gone up. He crouched, lay down like a lion, and like a lioness; who will rouse him?

familiar.text: Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

modern.text: Judah is a young lion— my son, you return from the prey. Like a lion he crouches and lies down; like a lioness, who dares to rouse him?

original.text: גּ֤וּר אַרְיֵה֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה מִטֶּ֖רֶף בְּנִ֣י עָלִ֑יתָ כָּרַ֨ע רָבַ֧ץ כְּאַרְיֵ֛ה וּכְלָבִ֖יא מִ֥י יְקִימֶֽנּוּ

verses.restored: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until Shiloh/tribute comes, and to him shall be the obedience of peoples.

familiar.text: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

modern.text: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the staff from between his feet, until Shiloh comes and the allegiance of the nations is his.

original.text: לֹֽא יָס֥וּר שֵׁ֨בֶט֙ מִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וּמְחֹקֵ֖ק מִבֵּ֣ין רַגְלָ֑יו עַ֚ד כִּֽי יָבֹ֣א שילה וְל֖וֹ יִקְּהַ֥ת עַמִּֽים

verses.restored: Binding his donkey to the vine, and his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he washes his garment in wine and his robe in the blood of grapes.

familiar.text: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:

modern.text: He ties his donkey to the vine, his colt to the choicest branch. He washes his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

original.text: אֹסְרִ֤י לַגֶּ֨פֶן֙ עירה וְלַשֹּׂרֵקָ֖ה בְּנִ֣י אֲתֹנ֑וֹ כִּבֵּ֤ס בַּיַּ֨יִן֙ לְבֻשׁ֔וֹ וּבְדַם עֲנָבִ֖ים סותה

verses.restored: His eyes are dark/red from wine, and his teeth white from milk.

familiar.text: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

modern.text: His eyes are darker than wine, and his teeth are whiter than milk.

original.text: חַכְלִילִ֥י עֵינַ֖יִם מִיָּ֑יִן וּלְבֶן שִׁנַּ֖יִם מֵחָלָֽב

verses.restored: Zebulun shall dwell by the shore of seas; he shall be a shore for ships, and his flank shall be toward Sidon.

familiar.text: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.

modern.text: Zebulun shall dwell by the seashore and become a harbor for ships; his border shall extend to Sidon.

original.text: זְבוּלֻ֕ן לְח֥וֹף יַמִּ֖ים יִשְׁכֹּ֑ן וְהוּא֙ לְח֣וֹף אֳנִיּ֔וֹת וְיַרְכָת֖וֹ עַל צִידֹֽן

verses.restored: Issachar is a strong donkey lying down between the saddlebags.

familiar.text: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:

modern.text: Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds.

original.text: יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר חֲמֹ֣ר גָּ֑רֶם רֹבֵ֖ץ בֵּ֥ין הַֽמִּשְׁפְּתָֽיִם

verses.restored: He saw that rest was good and the land pleasant; he bent his shoulder to bear and became a servant at forced labor.

familiar.text: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.

modern.text: He saw that his resting place was good and that his land was pleasant, so he bent his shoulder to the burden and submitted to labor as a servant.

original.text: וַיַּ֤רְא מְנֻחָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב וְאֶת הָאָ֖רֶץ כִּ֣י נָעֵ֑מָה וַיֵּ֤ט שִׁכְמוֹ֙ לִסְבֹּ֔ל וַיְהִ֖י לְמַס עֹבֵֽד

verses.restored: Dan shall judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel.

familiar.text: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

modern.text: Dan shall provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.

original.text: דָּ֖ן יָדִ֣ין עַמּ֑וֹ כְּאַחַ֖ד שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, a viper by the path, biting the horse’s heels so that its rider falls backward.

familiar.text: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

modern.text: He will be a snake by the road, a viper in the path that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward.

original.text: יְהִי דָן֙ נָחָ֣שׁ עֲלֵי דֶ֔רֶךְ שְׁפִיפֹ֖ן עֲלֵי אֹ֑רַח הַנֹּשֵׁךְ֙ עִקְּבֵי ס֔וּס וַיִּפֹּ֥ל רֹכְב֖וֹ אָחֽוֹר

verses.restored: For your salvation I wait, Eternal.

familiar.text: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.

modern.text: I await Your salvation, O LORD.

original.text: לִֽישׁוּעָתְךָ֖ קִוִּ֥יתִי יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Gad, raiders shall raid him, but he shall raid at their heel.

familiar.text: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

modern.text: Gad will be attacked by raiders, but he will attack their heels.

original.text: גָּ֖ד גְּד֣וּד יְגוּדֶ֑נּוּ וְה֖וּא יָגֻ֥ד עָקֵֽב

verses.restored: From Asher, his bread shall be rich, and he shall give royal delicacies.

familiar.text: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

modern.text: Asher’s food will be rich; he shall provide royal delicacies.

original.text: מֵאָשֵׁ֖ר שְׁמֵנָ֣ה לַחְמ֑וֹ וְה֥וּא יִתֵּ֖ן מַֽעֲדַנֵּי מֶֽלֶךְ

verses.restored: Naphtali is a doe let loose, giving beautiful words/fawns.

familiar.text: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.

modern.text: Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.

original.text: נַפְתָּלִ֖י אַיָּלָ֣ה שְׁלֻחָ֑ה הַנֹּתֵ֖ן אִמְרֵי שָֽׁפֶר

verses.restored: Joseph is a fruitful son, a fruitful son by a spring; daughters/branches run over the wall.

familiar.text: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:

modern.text: Joseph is a fruitful vine— a fruitful vine by a spring, whose branches scale the wall.

original.text: בֵּ֤ן פֹּרָת֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף בֵּ֥ן פֹּרָ֖ת עֲלֵי עָ֑יִן בָּנ֕וֹת צָעֲדָ֖ה עֲלֵי שֽׁוּר

verses.restored: Archers bitterly attacked him, shot at him, and harassed him.

familiar.text: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:

modern.text: The archers attacked him with bitterness; they aimed at him in hostility.

original.text: וַֽיְמָרֲרֻ֖הוּ וָרֹ֑בּוּ וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֻ֖הוּ בַּעֲלֵ֥י חִצִּֽים

verses.restored: Yet his bow remained firm, and the arms of his hands were agile by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, from there the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel.

familiar.text: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

modern.text: Yet he steadied his bow, and his strong arms were tempered by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, in the name of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,

original.text: וַתֵּ֤שֶׁב בְּאֵיתָן֙ קַשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַיָּפֹ֖זּוּ זְרֹעֵ֣י יָדָ֑יו מִידֵי֙ אֲבִ֣יר יַעֲקֹ֔ב מִשָּׁ֥ם רֹעֶ֖ה אֶ֥בֶן יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: By the Divine of your father who helps you, and by Shaddai who blesses you, with blessings of heavens above, blessings of the deep crouching below, blessings of breasts and womb.

familiar.text: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

modern.text: by the God of your father who helps you, and by the Almighty who blesses you, with blessings of the heavens above, with blessings of the depths below, with blessings of the breasts and womb.

original.text: מֵאֵ֨ל אָבִ֜יךָ וְיַעְזְרֶ֗ךָּ וְאֵ֤ת שַׁדַּי֙ וִיבָ֣רְכֶ֔ךָּ בִּרְכֹ֤ת שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ מֵעָ֔ל בִּרְכֹ֥ת תְּה֖וֹם רֹבֶ֣צֶת תָּ֑חַת בִּרְכֹ֥ת שָׁדַ֖יִם וָרָֽחַם

verses.restored: The blessings of your father are stronger than the blessings of my ancestors, to the boundary of the everlasting hills. May they be on Joseph’s head, on the crown of the one set apart from his brothers.

familiar.text: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

modern.text: The blessings of your father have surpassed the blessings of the ancient mountains and the bounty of the everlasting hills. May they rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince of his brothers.

original.text: בִּרְכֹ֣ת אָבִ֗יךָ גָּֽבְרוּ֙ עַל בִּרְכֹ֣ת הוֹרַ֔י עַֽד תַּאֲוַ֖ת גִּבְעֹ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם תִּֽהְיֶ֨ין֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ יוֹסֵ֔ף וּלְקָדְקֹ֖ד נְזִ֥יר אֶחָֽיו

verses.restored: Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he eats prey, and in the evening he divides spoil.

familiar.text: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

modern.text: Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey, in the evening he divides the plunder.”

original.text: בִּנְיָמִין֙ זְאֵ֣ב יִטְרָ֔ף בַּבֹּ֖קֶר יֹ֣אכַל עַ֑ד וְלָעֶ֖רֶב יְחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל

verses.restored: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and he blessed them; each according to his blessing he blessed them.

familiar.text: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

modern.text: These are the tribes of Israel, twelve in all, and this was what their father said to them. He blessed them, and he blessed each one with a suitable blessing. The Death of Jacob

original.text: כָּל אֵ֛לֶּה שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר וְ֠זֹאת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֨ר לָהֶ֤ם אֲבִיהֶם֙ וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אוֹתָ֔ם אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כְּבִרְכָת֖וֹ בֵּרַ֥ךְ אֹתָֽם

verses.restored: He commanded them and said, I am being gathered to my people; bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite.

familiar.text: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

modern.text: Then Jacob instructed them, “I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite.

original.text: וַיְצַ֣ו אוֹתָ֗ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ אֲנִי֙ נֶאֱסָ֣ף אֶל עַמִּ֔י קִבְר֥וּ אֹתִ֖י אֶל אֲבֹתָ֑י אֶל הַ֨מְּעָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּשְׂדֵ֖ה עֶפְר֥וֹן הַֽחִתִּֽי

verses.restored: In the cave in the field of Machpelah, before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial possession.

familiar.text: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

modern.text: The cave is in the field of Machpelah near Mamre, in the land of Canaan. This is the field Abraham purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.

original.text: בַּמְּעָרָ֞ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בִּשְׂדֵ֧ה הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵ֖א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ קָנָ֨ה אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה מֵאֵ֛ת עֶפְרֹ֥ן הַחִתִּ֖י לַאֲחֻזַּת קָֽבֶר

verses.restored: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his woman; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his woman; and there I buried Leah.

familiar.text: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

modern.text: There Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah are buried, and there I buried Leah.

original.text: שָׁ֣מָּה קָֽבְר֞וּ אֶת אַבְרָהָ֗ם וְאֵת֙ שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ שָׁ֚מָּה קָבְר֣וּ אֶת יִצְחָ֔ק וְאֵ֖ת רִבְקָ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְשָׁ֥מָּה קָבַ֖רְתִּי אֶת לֵאָֽה

verses.restored: The field and the cave that is in it were bought from the sons of Heth.

familiar.text: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.

modern.text: The field and the cave that is in it were purchased from the Hittites.”

original.text: מִקְנֵ֧ה הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה וְהַמְּעָרָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר בּ֖וֹ מֵאֵ֥ת בְּנֵי חֵֽת

verses.restored: When Jacob finished commanding his sons, he gathered his feet into the bed, expired, and was gathered to his people.

familiar.text: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

modern.text: When Jacob had finished instructing his sons, he pulled his feet into the bed and breathed his last, and he was gathered to his people.

original.text: וַיְכַ֤ל יַעֲקֹב֙ לְצַוֺּ֣ת אֶת בָּנָ֔יו וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף רַגְלָ֖יו אֶל הַמִּטָּ֑ה וַיִּגְוַ֖ע וַיֵּאָ֥סֶף אֶל עַמָּֽיו
